+ * Shared helper that installs the 8-plugin "mustang" sandbox stack (arrow-base,
+ * arrow-flight-rpc + 6 sandbox analytics/DSL plugins) into a CURRENT-version Gradle
+ * test cluster. Applied by qa/ modules whose testclusters run the current release.
+ * This script is a NO-OP unless the build is invoked with -Dsandbox.enabled=true.
+ * settings.gradle (L157-161) only includes the sandbox/ projects under that flag, while
+ * qa/ is always included, so every project(':sandbox:...') reference MUST sit behind the
+ * guard -- otherwise a plain (non-sandbox) build fails at configuration time because the
+ * sandbox projects do not exist in the project graph.
+ * NOT applicable to BWC (mixed old/new version) clusters: an old-version node runs on its
+ * bundled older JDK and rejects these plugins -- PluginsService.verifyCompatibility (semver
+ * range vs Version.CURRENT) and JarHell.checkJavaVersion (X-Compile-Target-JDK=25 exceeds
+ * the bundled JRE). Only wire this into current-version clusters.
+// Feature guard. Kept as a project ext so consuming modules can bump their
+// expected.plugins.count assertions only when the stack is actually installed.
+    // ext.nativeLibPath is set during dataformat-native's own configuration (build.gradle
+    // ~L256). Force that project to be evaluated before we read the ext below, since qa/
+    // module evaluation order relative to sandbox/ is not otherwise guaranteed.
+    // The native opensearch_native .so/.dylib must exist before any node boots, or the node
+    // dies with "Failed to load native library". Every REST integ test task depends on it.
+ * No-op when sandboxStackEnabled is false. Otherwise installs the stack onto the given
+ * test cluster. Plugins whose last path segment is listed in alreadyInstalled are skipped
+ * (e.g. smoke-test-arrow-plugins already installs arrow-base + arrow-flight-rpc, so it
+    // Install order matters: opensearch-plugin install --batch runs the zips in list order
+    // (OpenSearchNode.java:549-556) and a plugin that declares another in extendedPlugins
+    // must be listed AFTER its dependency, or the install-time jarHell check fails. Hence
+    // arrow-base precedes arrow-flight-rpc, and the analytics/DSL plugins follow.
+    // Arrow/Flight + DataFusion native access flags on JDK 25. -D... is rejected here
+    // (must be systemProperty), so only --add-opens / --enable-native-access / -da go via jvmArgs.
+    // Calcite assertion namespace disabled; -ea remains on elsewhere.
+    // Arrow's Netty allocation manager needs Unsafe access on JDK 25.
+    // Directory holding the DataFusion native library (opensearch_native), passed to the node.
+    // Feature flags required by the pluggable dataformat / streaming transport stack.
+  // Adds the 6 sandbox mustang plugins on top; arrow-base/arrow-flight-rpc are already
+  // installed above, so they are passed as alreadyInstalled to avoid a double-install.
+// When the sandbox stack is enabled, installSandboxStack adds 6 sandbox plugins on top of
+// the 2 arrow plugins counted above, so the expected node plugin count grows by 6.
+// Only the 2 OpenSearchRestTestCase ITs run against this Gradle testcluster; the 14
+// HttpSmokeTestCase ITs boot in-JVM nodes via OpenSearchIntegTestCase and are NOT covered
* We have to disable setting the number of available processors as tests in the same JVM randomize processors and will step on each
// Plugins that require non-default JVM flags (e.g. io.netty.noUnsafe=false for Arrow's
// Netty allocation manager) are tested separately in qa/smoke-test-arrow-plugins.
